content:
alex: Heads-up — pushing canary for model-rewrite in ~30m. I want to activate automatic fallback chain: model_variant -> regional_failover -> capacity_backoff. WDYT? @nora @deepak

nora: High-level ok. Need telemetry: per-variant latency + error rate and per-region capacity signals. Also cooldowns.

deepak: Agree. Proposed thresholds:
- variant fallback: error_rate > 5% AND p95 latency delta > 1200ms over baseline for 5m
- regional failover: region_gpu_util > 85% sustained 3m
- capacity backoff: scale down canary traffic to 50%, then 10% if repeated

jen: UX: console should show a 'fallback active' pill on the route with reason + link to runbook. Also add a 'force keep' toggle for SEs.

alex: Draft policy YAML (for runtime):
```yaml
fallback_chain:
  - name: variant
    condition:
      - metric: variant_error_rate
        op: ">"
        value: 0.05
      - metric: variant_p95_latency_delta_ms
        op: ">"
        value: 1200
    duration_s: 300
    action:
      type: swap_model
      target: stable
  - name: regional
    condition:
      - metric: region_gpu_util
        op: ">"
        value: 0.85
    duration_s: 180
    action:
      type: reroute_region
      policy: next_available
  - name: capacity_backoff
    action:
      type: reduce_traffic
      steps: [50, 10]
      cooldown_s: 600
``` 

nora: Add cooldown windows, signal dedupe (don't react to transient blips). Also limit automatic reroute so it doesn't violate per-tenant reserved capacity.

deepak: Telemetry queries I used in the sim:
- variant error rate: `increase(errors_total{variant="v2"}[5m]) / increase(requests_total{variant="v2"}[5m])`
- p95 delta: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,variant)) - baseline_p95`
- region util: `avg_over_time(gpu_utilization_percent{region=~".*"}[3m])`

jen: Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-fallback>

alex: small test commands to reproduce locally:
```
# hit canary
ab -n 1000 -c 50 https://canary.redwood/run
# tail relevant logs
kubectl logs -l app=runtime -c router | grep "variant=v2" | tail -n 200
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: model-rewrite canary at 2109876723. Sending alert to #eng-oncall.

oncall-runbook-bot: Reminder: if automatic fallback triggers twice in 30m, escalate to SRE lead.

nora: OK. I'll wire the policy into the canary config and add UI bits for pill + manual override. Deepak please validate telemetry thresholds in staging.

deepak: Will run sims and post results here. If we see noise we'll lengthen durations.

jen: I'll add console copy and a short tooltip explaining what each fallback means.

alex: Thanks. We'll watch the canary and be ready to cut traffic manually if needed. :thumbsup:
